deadline.value: PhD applications are due January 15, 2027, but applying by January 5 gives priority for financial support.
deadline.quote: Applications for fall admissions for the PhD program are due by January 15, 2027. | Students who submit their applications by January 5 will receive priority consideration for financial support opportunities.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; you may submit it if you wish.
gre_general.quote: Application to our graduate program DOES NOT require a GRE. If you take the GRE and want to include it on your application, you can submit official results

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 95 is preferred for admittance.
toefl_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 95, an IELTS score of 7.0, and/or a minimum Duolingo score of 120 is preferred for admittance.

ielts_min.quote: A minimum TOEFL score of 95, an IELTS score of 7.0, and/or a minimum Duolingo score of 120 is preferred for admittance.

supervisor.value: The page asks you to name faculty of interest in your statement but does not say a supervisor is required.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students receive teaching or research assistantships with a stipend, medical benefits and full tuition.
funding.quote: Our full-time PhD students receive competitive teaching or research assistantships comprising of an annual stipend, medical benefits, and full coverage of graduate tuition.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The page also says it is 'now accepting applications for fall 2026', an old line; the January 15, 2027 date is the one stated for the PhD. The application fee is not on this page.
